workflow: AutoCAD 24.3 desktop COM creates twelve native entity families in a newly owned isolated process, drives SCALE from base 100,200 through a two-point Reference of 1000 to new length 2000, performs U, repeats with Copy/U, validates factor-one through a preceding MOVE sentinel and one U, then exercises numeric and point-based Reference lengths, refused zero/negative/coincident inputs and a mixed editable/locked pickset.
result: All twelve native families scaled uniformly by two with handles and properties preserved; aligned-dimension extension points and measurement scaled while its style-controlled text gap stayed constant, and U restored every semantic point. Copy created twelve fresh native handles. The factor-one sentinel proved AutoCAD creates a consumable undo entry despite unchanged geometry. Refused inputs and the locked object did not mutate, the non-certifying 2,0 probe remains assigned to F-052, and the exact owned AutoCAD process was terminated with no acad.exe left behind.
